education.description: We buy, sell and invest in small businesses and teach others how to get into the ownership seat.

I head the Latin America & US Offshore Investment Business, providing investments and market strategy to enable some of the worlds leading pensions, institutions and advisors to reach their investment goals. We've built a business from the ground up, to one of the fastest growing firms in LatAm.

Worked in Latin America and the US with Fortune 500 Companies, pensions, sovereign wealth funds, central banks, endowments, and foundations to manage their investment portfolios. We navigated some treacherous regulations and industry changes to raise billions in previously uncovered markets.
Degree with 3 international accreditations: Georgetown University, Corporate Masters of Business Administration - ESADE and Mestrado Executivo em Gestão Empresarial - FGV/EBAPE.

posts.caption:
@codiesanchez left a finance career managing hundreds of millions in assets to buy laundromats, car washes and roofing companies, then built a 15-million-follower movement teaching others to do the same.

Contrarian Thinking now operates across media, investment and advisory, and her new book Own or Be Owned is built around one core idea: know yourself before you follow anyone else's formula.

This is her story. Read the full feature online now (link in bio) and in print starting Sept. 22.

📷 : @jakechessum

Some sneak peaks of my new book Own or Be Owned 🤫

Comment OWN let’s get you your copy!

Before you say anything, swipe through the whole thing. In the 15 years I’ve been a part of the business and finance world, the cheapest option has almost never been the one winning. Set your value before someone sets it for you.
